The diagnostic + logging change is durable; the live_gguf claim (live_gguf_energy_mean=0.0, live_gguf_energy_std=0.0) was NOT validated on real GPU. Re-run on RTX 3090 with explicit model_specs is required in .260 before the fix can be cited as live-validated.

top_3_gaps_for_260.gap: exp2727 verifier-energy fix is adversarial-flagged: 11.5s wall-clock contradicts live-GPU + GGUF + CUDA preconditions. Diagnostic logging is real but the live_gguf_energy_mean=0.0 claim was not produced by an actual model load. Until re-run on RTX 3090 with explicit model_specs + reproducibility_checksum + duration >= 60s, the 'verifier is now discriminative on live SOTA GGUF' claim is provisional.
top_3_gaps_for_260.suggested_task: .260 exp(N+1) verifier-energy-debug-v2-live-gpu: re-execute the verify() path through tier0s_halluguard.py + nup_probe.py on Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-GGUF on RTX 3090 (gpu=0), record duration_s >= 60, model_specs, random_seed, reproducibility_checksum. Acceptance gate: at least 5 distinct non-zero energy values across 30 live FoVer + 30 live out-of-corpus inputs; flagged_adversarial MUST be false.

top_3_gaps_for_260.gap: exp2731 Semantic Energy Tier 0g works on synthetic (energies 8.4-9.1, non-degenerate) but live GGUF still emits identical 9.085 across all 3 inputs (gguf_non_degenerate=false), and the artifact is itself adversarial-flagged (3.3s duration). The tier 0g cluster-energy formulation may be model-invariant when the upstream GGUF returns the same probability vector — i.e., the upstream model is the degenerate component, not Tier 0g.
top_3_gaps_for_260.suggested_task: .260 exp(N+2) tier0g-live-gpu-rerun-and-upstream-diagnosis: re-run Tier 0g on RTX 3090 with duration_s >= 60, AND instrument the GGUF call path to capture whether unsloth/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-GGUF returns identical logits for distinct inputs (sign of fast-path bypass or KV-cache leak). Acceptance gate: either gguf_non_degenerate=true on >= 20 inputs OR a root-cause artifact naming the upstream component returning constant logits.

top_3_gaps_for_260.gap: OTV fast-path probe (exp2728) has AUROC=0.25 (worse than random); only the tier-routing fallback rescued the savings claim. Both signal that selection-stage and probe-stage gains at the current k=15 ensemble are exhausted; further work in either direction is unlikely to compound.
